summary.text: Ralph Heap is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 10, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: In a candidate-submitted profile in the 2024 voter guide, Heap describes being a fourth-generation Arizonan and an orthopedic surgeon in the East Valley for 40 years.
The profile says Heap graduated magna cum laude from Arizona State University, received a medical degree from the University of Arizona, and has volunteered on overseas medical missions.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 10 (candidate-submitted statements)
